metadata.title: Cabbage Salad
metadata.description:
This salad of thin crisp shredded cabbage, onions and tomatoes cannot get simpler that this. It takes minimal effort,  tastes great and the best part is that you can experiment with it by dressing it with any choice ingredient or just sprinkle some roasted ground peanuts or roasted sesame. and make yourself a bowl full of healthy goodness. 

This is something that we make every other day and have with our meals.
